mission: SNKRDUNK fix 3 (owner 'go perfectionist' 2026-11-03): the 37 listings the seeds found have no set code and no proposal. (1) Bandai-proven label rows for EB-02 to EB-04, OP-05, OP-06, OP-08 to OP-17 in release_product_aliases.py (collector and worker copies, byte-identical), proven against the committed fresh capture of both Bandai Card Lists (bandai-label-evidence run 41626034881); the three evidence checks are re-derived from that file in a new always-on worker test. (2) SNKRDUNK discovery persists proposals for its new candidates (discovery.with_proposals: refresh_discovery_proposals, outside the browser deadline, in a savepoint; a failure is recorded on the cursor and never costs the discovery result). (3) New owner-gated ops-write runbook snkr-candidate-refresh catches up the backlog: empty set codes from the collector's own evidence_from_listing, then proposals through discovery's path; plan SHA, dry run first, no mapping. Note: discovery.py now imports discovery_proposal_refresh (function-local), so future source_mapping_proposals.py changes count as SNKRDUNK collector runtime inputs.
